issue: Sales Partner application banner could reappear for Staff accounts because the module trusted a stale saved-user role while Software Tools had already resolved the live role as Staff.
fixes: Uses live Software Tools affiliate bar as an authoritative Staff+ signal
Scans session/local user objects and direct role cache keys
Checks software role globals and staff cache
Prevents showPartnerSection from rendering whenever any Staff+ signal is present
Observes affiliate bar role state so banner hides immediately after role resolution
